text: Best seat in the house. It took an evacuation, some rain and lines but we made it back in!
translated_text: 房子里最好的座位。虽然经历了疏散、下雨和排队，但我们还是回来了！

text: People are still trickling into their seats as President Trump begins his speech.
translated_text: 当特朗普总统开始讲话时，人们仍在陆续入座。

text:
“Good evening America if you think that was easy it wasn’t.”

Trump said they did the right thing by evacuating everyone.
translated_text:
“晚上好，美国，如果你认为这很容易，那么事实并非如此。”

特朗普表示，他们疏散所有人，做了正确的事。

text: “Welcome back!” staff tell us as they welcome us back to the Salut to America stage area.
translated_text: “欢迎回来！”工作人员在欢迎我们回到“向美国致敬”舞台区时告诉我们。

text:
Currently.  
Massive lines waiting to get screened again to get back into Salut to America.
translated_text:
现在。  
大量队伍等待再次接受安检，以返回“向美国致敬”。

text: Singing in the rain. People waiting to get back into the Salut to America break into patriotic song.
translated_text: 雨中歌唱。等待返回“向美国致敬”的人们开始唱起爱国歌曲。
